title: Environmental Semiotics, Puszta Landscape, and Natural Metaphors

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Hungarian culture draws fundamental symbols from its landscape. *A rög* (the native sod / clod of earth) represents physical attachment to homeland, while *a puszta* symbolizes both infinite freedom and existential loneliness.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Agricultural and hydrological metaphors (*elsivatagosodás, forrásvidék, gyökérzet*) migrate into cultural diagnosis: an era lacking creativity is described as *szellemi aszály* (intellectual drought).
